description: One ticker's state: latest snapshot, one date, a start/end series (up to 50 rows; for a longer range add sample=even or use query), or band events. For events give field and optionally band: each says when the band was entered, what it left and how long that had lasted; stats=true returns how often each band was entered. fields trims to sections or paths, e.g. trend, momentum.rsi_zone, fundamentals.pe_ratio. Market regimes are in get_market.

adjustment.description: Price basis: split (default), split_dividend (total return) or raw (as traded).

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

band.description: Only changes into this value, e.g. oversold.

context_ticker.description: Keep only events when this second asset was in context_band, e.g. SPY. Needs context_field and context_band.

field.description: Band field for events, e.g. momentum_rsi_zone.

meta.description: Add stability metadata (_meta) to every band.

sample.description: Up to 50 rows spread evenly across start/end.

stats.description: How often each band was entered, instead of the event list.

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

name: get_summary
